title: Night in the Woods character-glow mathematical reconstruction and atomic requirements
status: Proposed; mathematical consistency checked; original shader and visual fidelity not verified.
scope: Character/source-local glow only. Environmental art, existing project code, and deployment are not changed.

metadata_defaults.owners: Logical responsibility boundaries only; not claims about current repository paths.
metadata_defaults.supersession: None. This proposal does not replace existing authoritative requirements.
metadata_defaults.tests: Positive, negative, and boundary tests are plans unless an executed mathematical evidence item is explicitly linked.
metadata_defaults.numeric_thresholds: Provisional acceptance gates for this selected reconstruction profile, not original game measurements.
metadata_defaults.precedence: Preserve inherited constraints; source authorization and accessibility cannot be bypassed by style. Exact implementation strategy is not prescribed if output invariants are qualified.

USR-CURRENT.text: mathematically capture night in the woods' dream sequence character glow, then turn that math into atoms

USR-PRIOR.text: Crisp silhouette; short soft low-intensity glow; native-color-preserving adaptations; no giant orb, white wash, flashing, or conventional illumination as a substitute; optional slow shallow asynchronous breathing; reduced-effects equivalence; atomic provenance and adversarial verification. Recalled context is not a substitute for later reconciliation with an authoritative project register.

OBS-01.observed: Crisp cyan/blue character regions and magenta eye accents against a dark scene; a much larger circular luminous world feature must not be mistaken for the character halo radius.
OBS-01.limitation: Still imagery; no recovered shader, pixel-fitted parameters, or reference motion timing.

REF-COLOR.supports: Linear-light color addition, alpha compositing, and not making essential information depend solely on color.

REF-BLOOM.supports: Bloom as outward light fringes and the distinction between threshold, intensity, and scatter/radius.
REF-BLOOM.limitation: Does not identify the original game's shader or establish that this game used this renderer.

REF-MOTION.supports: Respecting preferences and controls for nonessential animation.
REF-MOTION.limitation: Used as a design principle, not a claim that the optional luminance waveform alone establishes WCAG conformance.

DEC-SCOPE.text: Scoped mathematical reconstruction and requirements proposal only. No repository implementation or deployment is performed.

DEC-SEED.text: The v0.1 numerical seed is selected for a visible near field and weak compact tail, not extracted from the original game.

MODEL-EQ01.definition: Decode encoded sRGB c to linear light: c/12.92 for c<=0.04045; ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4 otherwise.

MODEL-EQ02.definition: A=sum_r A_r<=1; P=sum_r A_r C_r; E=sum_r A_r e_r C_emit,r. Region masks partition effective visible coverage; P and E are premultiplied fields.

MODEL-EQ03.definition: q=|u|/sigma; W(q)=1 for q<=2.5, 1-(3s^2-2s^3) for 2.5<q<3 with s=(q-2.5)/0.5, 0 for q>=3. K_sigma(u)=exp(-q^2/2) W(q)/Z_sigma with Z_sigma the 2D integral. sigma_k=rho_k h.

MODEL-EQ04.definition: G_raw=g p(t) sum_k w_k (K_sigma_k * E). Seed rho=(0.012,0.035,0.075), w=(0.65,0.30,0.05), g=0.28. Sum source fields before the overlap limiter.

MODEL-EQ05.definition: For y=Y(G_raw), f(y)=y if y<=b else b+(c-b)(1-exp(-(y-b)/(c-b))), 0<=b<c. G=0 if y=0, otherwise G_raw*f(y)/y. Seed b=0.3Y0, c=0.5Y0 for declared reference luminance unit Y0.

MODEL-EQ06.definition: I_linear=P+(1-A)(B+G); I_display=Encode(T(I_linear)). B contains no copy of this subject. In a multisubject renderer use the crisp already-composited scene J and its protected-core coverage A_protected: I_linear=J+(1-A_protected)G.

MODEL-EQ07.definition: Depth-aware extension: G_i(x)=g_i p_i sum_k w_k integral K_sigma_ik(x-y) chi_i(x,y) E_i(y) dy. E_i already excludes unauthorized and occluded source fragments. chi=0 for nearer opaque foreground destinations, else 1 (fractional coverage permitted). Do not renormalize after chi.

MODEL-EQ08.definition: Default p=1. Optional adaptation: p_i(t)=1+0.02 sin(2pi t/31+phi_i)+0.01 sin(2pi t/47+psi_i), stable phases; p in [0.97,1.03], |dp/dt|<=0.005390516/s. Reduced motion p=1.

MODEL-EQ09.definition: For an untruncated Gaussian and an isolated straight edge: G(d)/E0=(g/2) sum_k w_k erfc(d/(sqrt(2)sigma_k)), d>=0. The compact-kernel seed is evaluated using its actual normalized radial integral, not by treating this formula as exact after truncation.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: A protected dark scene versus a glow too weak to see
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Apply both a positive near-edge residual requirement and a small far-tail limit; zero glow is not full-profile conformance.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: Crisp character detail versus spatial diffusion
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Filter only the separate emission field and preserve the opaque core in composition.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: Reference imitation versus native-color preservation in another project
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Use separate named palette profiles rather than overriding the target project's palette.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: Finite darkness support versus an infinite Gaussian tail
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Use a normalized compact tapered kernel; retain the erfc formula only as the untruncated explanatory analogue.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: Stable glow energy versus partial occlusion
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Occlusion removes light; do not restore removed energy by renormalizing the surviving kernel.

conflicts_and_resolutions.tension: A mathematically specified profile versus an unverified visual match
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Keep numerical seeds provisional and require native-size reference approval.
